description.p: ArrowLoop keeps two folders in step, in both directions. One can be on this computer, the other on your own server, a NAS, a phone or one of the many cloud services rclone supports. Before a run moves anything, it shows you the plan: every copy, every deletion and every conflict, one row each. Untick a row and that file stays exactly as it is.

ul.li: Syncs in both directions, or one way if you prefer
Remembers what both sides last agreed on, so a deleted file never comes back and a new one never disappears
Reaches SFTP, SMB, WebDAV, Nextcloud, S3, OneDrive, Google Drive and over 60 other services
Runs on a schedule or as soon as files change, and waits in the tray in between
Keeps both versions when a file was changed on both sides
Writes every run into a history: what was copied, deleted or left for next time, and why

description.p: So that no file gets lost:

ul.li: A deletion moves the file into a trash on that side rather than removing it for good
A run that would delete more than half of your files stops and asks first
A side that suddenly looks empty, such as a drive that did not mount, is never taken as everything deleted

description.p: There is no account, no server of ours in between and no analytics. The Flatpak can reach your home folder and the drives and shares under /media, /run/media and /mnt. A folder anywhere else needs a filesystem override before a job can sync it.

screenshot.caption: The jobs, each with its schedule and its last runs
The plan of a run, with a conflict to decide

description.p: A job waits for its drive instead of failing, and a file left for later only fails a run when it is left twice.

ul.li: A job pauses while its external or network drive is away and runs again once it is back
A local side is read once, so the separate check for links is gone
Infomaniak kDrive and dosya.dev join the clouds
The Apps tile offers the Flatpak

description.p: The Automatic backups card picks its folder in the folder picker.

ul.li: Choose a folder beside the backup folder opens the folder picker
Import settings puts a backup back, so the card no longer has its own Restore button

description.p: Open and edit the jobs of your other paired instances.

ul.li: A job's name on another instance's card opens it, and Edit changes it there
That instance checks every change by its own rules and only takes its own targets, drives and the folders it already syncs

description.p: ArrowLoop opens on an Overview, pairs your instances with twelve words, backs up its settings on its own and comes as a Flatpak.

ul.li: The Overview shows how all jobs and paired instances stand
Pair a server, the desktop app and the phone app with twelve words and see each other's jobs
The settings are backed up every night, at a time you choose
Import takes a FolderSync export or a luckyBackup profile
OxiCloud has a tile of its own

description.p: Put the jobs in your own order and see them in a compact list, go true black on OLED screens and let the accent take your system's colour.

ul.li: Drag a job by its handle, or press Alt and an arrow key, to put the jobs in your own order
The job list has a compact view with one row per job
OLED puts the dark look on true black
The accent can take your system's colour
The lists sort, filter and search from their own headings
The sign-in page has a new look

description.p: Builds move to Go 1.27.3, and the engine picks up a fix in its compression library.
